question: what actually moved MTEB-STS across 19 adapter configurations

table.tested: soup of v18 and v21a at alpha 0.50
soup of v18 and v21a at alpha 0.30
soup of v18 and v21a at alpha 0.70
teacher distillation, mxbai cosines as continuous labels
STSB upsampled against the distilled pool
table.verdict: negative: upsampling did not recover English
negative: more teachers did not help

table.tested: weight soup of v18 and v20 at alpha 0.70
CoSENT over 200K binary NLI pairs plus graded STSB
table.verdict: mixed: cross-lingual up, graded English down

table.tested: CoSENT rank loss on STSB, lr 1e-5, 5 epochs
weight soup of v18 and v20 at alpha 0.50
table.verdict: negative: even mix over-tilts toward the weaker parent

table.tested: NLI labels mapped to graded similarity {1.0, 0.5, 0.0}
table.verdict: negative: NLI labels are not similarity labels

table.tested: gentler CoSENT schedule chosen on dev Spearman
table.verdict: null: barely moved off the warm start

table.tested: second epoch of NLI-only InfoNCE at lower lr
table.verdict: negative: the recipe was already saturated, more steps is noise
negative: regression on absolute cosines overfits one domain

table.tested: E5-style query/passage prefixes bolted onto a warm start
table.verdict: catastrophic: prefixes destroy a warm-started encoder

excluded_not_comparable.v22c_a050_beyond: 14 subsets, not the same 39 as every other run

no_variance_estimate.claim: v22c_a050 beats v18 by +0.0037 mean MTEB-STS
no_variance_estimate.why: the six *_seed{0,1,2} directories are byte-identical copies, not training-seed replicates. MTEB evaluation of a fixed checkpoint is deterministic, so repeating it cannot estimate variance. No adapter was ever retrained with a different seed, so this gap has no error bar and may not be a real difference.
no_variance_estimate.to_fix: retrain v18 from v15a with >=3 training seeds and evaluate each; that gives the first genuine error bar for this line

reading: the negatives are the point. Prefix injection onto a warm start is catastrophic, regression on absolute cosines overfits, NLI labels are not similarity labels, and weight souping beat three separate training attempts at recovering English calibration.
